fields.Name: Approval
fields.Description: Agent needs explicit approval to proceed with an action. User responds with Approved or Rejected.

fields.Name: Information
fields.Description: Agent needs additional information or data from the user before it can continue processing.

fields.Name: Choice
fields.Description: Agent needs the user to select from a set of options. Options are defined in the request's ResponseSchema.

fields.Name: Review
fields.Description: Agent wants the user to review its output before proceeding. User can approve, request changes, or reject.

fields.Name: Custom
fields.Description: Agent-defined request type with a custom response schema. Used when none of the standard types apply.

fields.Name: Plan Approval
fields.Description: Agent requests approval on a structured execution or delivery plan contract before beginning implementation.

fields.Name: Criteria Change
fields.Description: Agent proposes or requests approval for a change to acceptance criteria, scope, or contract invariants.

fields.Name: Budget Increase
fields.Description: Agent requests authorization to raise cost, token, iteration, or elapsed-time budget limits for a work item.

fields.Name: Merge Approval
fields.Description: Agent requests human approval to merge a pull request or land validated changes into a protected branch.
